text: {Name} taught arithmetic at a school near {Place}. When new restrictions closed the school, the teacher visited pupils at home and continued the lessons from where each class had stopped.
self_review: An arithmetic teacher continued lessons in pupils' homes after restrictions closed the school.
source_pattern: The supplied Gobetti account documents teaching and later underground organizing; the other resistance research documents bans reshaping ordinary work.
fictional_changes: School closure and home lessons are plausible inventions. The supplied research does not establish this exact teaching practice; no historical source is claimed for it.
